questions.stem: What is a potential danger of excessive exposure to ultraviolet radiation?
questions.explanation: Excessive exposure to ultraviolet (UV) radiation can cause skin cancer, premature skin ageing, and eye damage (such as cataracts). UV is ionising radiation with enough energy to damage DNA in cells.

questions.stem: Why are microwaves used for satellite communications rather than radio waves?

options.text: Microwaves can pass through the Earth's atmosphere with less absorption and can be focused into narrow beams
Radio waves cannot travel through space
Microwaves travel faster than radio waves

questions.explanation: Microwaves are used for satellite communication because they can pass through the atmosphere with relatively little absorption and can be focused into narrow beams using dish aerials. This allows efficient, targeted communication with satellites. All EM waves travel at the same speed in a vacuum.
